name: The Cleopatra Clit Caresser
description: The Cleopatra concept translates the clasped-hands silhouette into a narrow, rounded detail. The curled fingers and spiral wrist band carry the shape of the original bronze into a more slender profile.
finishes: A warm copper tone that brings out the curves of the hand.
Deep brown bronze with highlights along the raised edges.
artDescription: Concept rendering of slim copper-bronze hands with curled fingers and a spiral cuff
